title: Furious FPS (GREEN)
description: A Modpack That Drastically Improves Performance Using Resource Packs, Mods And Settings.
body:
# FURIOUS FPS (GREEN)

**is a lightweight, high-performance Minecraft modpack built specifically to boost your FPS. Whether you're playing on a low-end PC or just want a smoother experience, this modpack is for you.**

![The Logo Of The Modpack :](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec81716cc852054a64e760f4b3f19d650ec9323b.png)

## Features : 

_FPS Boosting Mods: Includes top performance-enhancing mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight to maximize your frame rate._

_Utility Enhancements: Quality-of-life mods such as voice-chat, more render distance, better UI, and more—without bloating your game._

_Minimalist Approach: No unnecessary content. Just performance and essentials._

_Low-End Friendly: Designed to run even on modest hardware setups._

_Compatible & Customizable: Easily add or remove mods to suit your preferences._

_Whether you're PvPing, exploring, or building, Furious FPS (GREEN) ensures smooth gameplay every step of the way._

### NOTE : THIS MODPACK IS ONLY COMPATIBLE WITH NVIDIA GPUs (GRAPHICS CARDS)
###
